name: docs_search
description: Search official Bot Creator function documentation.

name: docs_get
description: Read a function document by its slug.

name: remote_list_bots
description: List the account's cloud bots.

name: remote_bot_status
description: Read a cloud bot's status.

name: remote_start_bot
description: Start a cloud bot using its current saved configuration.

name: remote_stop_bot
description: Stop a cloud bot.

name: local_list_bots
description: List bots saved in this application. Tokens and secrets are excluded.

name: local_bot_status
description: Read local runtime state for a bot.

name: local_start_bot
description: Start a bot on this device using its saved configuration.

name: local_stop_bot
description: Stop a bot on this device.

name: local_list_commands
description: Read command definitions saved locally for a bot.

name: local_block_registry
description: List supported BDFD functions and visual block types. For workflow mode, actions_json is a JSON array of blocks with type and payload; inspect existing commands for payload examples.

name: local_get_command
description: Read a local command and its revision before editing it.

name: local_create_command
description: Create and register a new slash command. Choose execution_mode bdfd_script for BDFD source, javascript for a JavaScript bot, or workflow for visual blocks on a Dart bot. BDFD and JavaScript use script; workflow uses actions_json (JSON array of action blocks). Default is the bot runtime's script mode. Inspect the bot runtime and block registry first. Requires approval.

name: local_update_command_execution
description: Update only an existing command's execution. Choose execution_mode bdfd_script, javascript or workflow. BDFD and JavaScript use script; workflow uses actions_json containing an array of visual action blocks. Preserve the Discord ID, name, options and permissions. Read local_get_command first and pass its revision. Requires approval.

name: local_update_command_options
description: Add, edit or remove a slash command option. Read the command first and pass its revision. Preserve execution and permissions; update existing Discord command and sync cloud. Requires approval.

name: local_update_command_settings
description: Update command description, default permissions, contexts or installation types. Read the command first. Requires approval.

name: local_list_workflows
description: List saved workflows with revisions.

name: local_get_workflow
description: Read a workflow and its revision before editing.

name: local_create_workflow
description: Create a standalone workflow. Inspect runtime, block registry and events first. JavaScript needs a JavaScript runtime; visual blocks or compiled BDFD need Dart. Requires approval.

name: local_update_workflow
description: Modify a saved workflow. Read it first and pass its revision. Preserve unspecified fields and use the bot runtime. Requires approval.

name: local_list_events
description: List supported workflow events and categories.

name: local_get_bot_configuration
description: Read bot profile, presence, variable definitions, schedules, webhooks and section revisions. Secrets excluded.

name: local_get_bot_presence
description: Read saved bot status and activity with revision.

name: local_update_bot_presence
description: Set saved status and activities, then synchronize cloud. Requires approval and current presence revision.

name: local_update_bot_profile
description: Change global Discord bot username. Read configuration and pass profile revision. Requires approval.

name: local_set_variable
description: Set a global variable or a scoped default definition. Pass variables section revision. Requires approval.

name: local_update_scheduled_trigger
description: Create or update a periodic workflow trigger. Pass scheduled_triggers section revision. Requires approval.

name: local_update_inbound_webhook
description: Create or update an inbound webhook linked to a workflow. Credentials are generated in the application and never exposed in chat. Pass inbound_webhooks revision. Requires approval.
